name: APIT tax bands (Tax Table No. 01) and EPF/ETF contribution rates
notes: APIT: personal relief Rs. 1,800,000 a year and bands from IRD Tax Table No. 01 for Y/A 2025/2026 (https://www.ird.gov.lk/en/publications/APIT_Tax_Tables/2025-2026/Table%20-%201/02.%20APIT_2526_Table_01_Text.pdf), stored as annual bands (Inland Revenue (Amendment) Act No. 02 of 2025); the monthly table is these figures divided by 12. On 2026-10-18 the IRD APIT page listed no 2026/2027 tables. EPF (employee 8%, employer 12%) under the EPF Act No. 15 of 1958 and ETF (employer 3%) under the ETF Act No. 46 of 1980 are statutory minimum rates.
